This critical opportunity is ideal for a technically capable engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, working across multiple engineering disciplines, and translating customer and business needs into robust, well-engineered solutions. You'll play a key role in establishing systems engineering best practice, driving technical governance, and ensuring products are released with confidence in their performance, safety, reliability, and compliance.

System Architecture & Design

• Champion systems engineering best practices across the business

• Proven experience maintaining requirements traceability
• Strong knowledge of verification and validation methodologies
• Experience leading risk assessments, FMEA activities, and technical reviews

• Ability to balance technical, commercial, regulatory, and operational considerations when making engineering decisions

• Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama, DOORS, or equivalent
• Knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and SysML
• Experience within analytical instrumentation, spectroscopy, gas analysis, process monitoring, or related technologies
• Familiarity with ISO 9001, CE/UKCA compliance, EMC, and product safety standards
• Exposure to automated testing, data analysis, Python, or LabVIEW
• INCOSE, Six Sigma, Project Management, Quality, or Atlassian/Jira certifications
Qualifications
• Degree-qualified in Systems Engineering, Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Electronics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline

At Servomex, you'll have the opportunity to work on technically challenging products that help customers improve safety, sustainability, efficiency, and performance across global industries. We're looking for a DRS Project Coordinator to help shape and deliver Asda's Deposit Return Scheme (DRS) strategy.

Working with teams across Buying, Supply Chain, Technology, Marketing, Retail Operations and external suppliers, you'll turn complex legislation, customer insights and market trends into practical plans that support a successful DRS launch.

• Develop and coordinate Asda's end-to-end DRS proposition across products, customers and suppliers.

• Strong commercial and analytical skills.
• Experience delivering complex projects across multiple stakeholders.
• Ability to turn data and insights into clear recommendations and action plans.
• Experience managing supplier relationships and influencing stakeholders.

• Commercial recommendations adopted and delivered across the business.
• Protection and growth of category performance.
• Increased customer engagement and store footfall through DRS initiatives.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment.
Why This Role Matters
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in one of the biggest changes facing UK retail. You'll help shape how Asda responds to DRS, ensuring we're ready for launch while creating a proposition that works for customers, suppliers and the business.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
Integrated Portfolio Solutions (IPS)
IPS provides a comprehensive combination of technology, analytics, and operational expertise to help investors manage the full investment lifecycle across public and private markets. Serving foundations, endowments, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, and asset managers, IPS delivers investment reporting, performance and risk analytics, data management, and operational support through a blend of Northern Trust proprietary technology and specialist third-party solutions. By integrating data, analytics, and workflows into a single operating model, IPS enables clients to make informed investment decisions, strengthen portfolio oversight, and enhance operational efficiency across multi-asset portfolios. This integrated approach provides clients with a scalable solution that combines leading technology, investment expertise, and operational support to meet increasingly complex portfolio management and reporting requirements.
Core services include:
• Investment Reporting & Analytics: Timely, accurate reporting and insights across public and private market investments.
• Performance & Risk Analytics: Performance measurement, attribution, exposure analysis, and risk reporting to support investment decision-making.
• Private Markets Solutions: Specialized operational services and reporting analytics for limited partners invested in private capital and other alternative investments.
• Workflow & Research Management: Digital tools that streamline document management, research workflows, and approval processes.
• Technology & Data Delivery: Secure access to investment data and analytics through web portals, dashboards, APIs, and robust data governance controls.

The role brings together cross-functional teams to deliver sophisticated solutions, resolve complex challenges, and maximize the value clients derive from Northern Trust’s capabilities. In addition, the position contributes to broader business objectives through strategic growth initiatives, governance and risk management activities, executive reporting, and senior stakeholder engagement.

Client Service Delivery
• Lead complex client initiatives across IPS product lines, coordinating delivery and managing stakeholder expectations ensuring clear communication, expectation management, and alignment.
• Develop a deep understanding of clients' investment structures, operating models, and reporting requirements.
• Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver solutions that balance client needs with operational and risk considerations.
• Build strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and key internal partners.
• Coordinate responses to complex client requests, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
• Manage client expectations, requirements, risks, and deliverables driving proactive resolution of client challenges and continuous service improvements.
• Prepare and manage executive-level reporting and escalations.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to deliver client outcomes.
• Translate client requirements into actionable delivery plans and oversee implementation.
• Support contract renewals, fee discussions, and commercial reviews.
• Contribute to client retention and revenue growth objectives.
• Coordinate incident management, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.
• Support Market Expansion initiatives for IPS’s respective product lines
Project and Change Management
• Lead delivery of client change requests, strategic enhancements, and operational improvements, managing milestones, dependencies, and communications.
• Work with Relationship Managers and Implementations to manage tasks related to IPS activities connected to Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
• Ensure successful execution of client remediation and transformation initiatives where required.
Role Requirements
This role is focused on enhancing the client experience for users of Northern Trust's performance, analytics, and private markets solutions.
The Service Delivery Manager is accountable for end-to-end client outcomes, coordinating cross-functional teams and proactively managing risks, dependencies, and issues to ensure the successful delivery of critical client services.
Working closely with IPS Client Servicing Leads, Relationship Managers, Product teams, and Technology partners, the role combines deep product knowledge with industry expertise to deliver exceptional service, drive continuous improvement, and maximise client value.
The successful candidate will be equally comfortable operating at both a strategic and operational level, engaging senior stakeholders on service performance, delivery risks, and strategic priorities while maintaining a detailed understanding of the data, analytical, and operational processes underpinning client deliverables.
The role requires the ability to lead complex, multi-disciplinary initiatives and leverage a strong understanding of investment performance, analytics, data management, and private markets to engage credibly with investment professionals and senior decision-makers. Proven ability to design and implement mobile low-level designs, APIs, and data models, and to work effectively with service-oriented or microservices-based backends.

Demonstrated proficiency with core Android development tools and practices, including version control, testing frameworks, debugging, performance optimization, and continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines.

Awareness of performance and reliability considerations on mobile (app start, scrolling performance, memory, battery) and experience using profiling/monitoring tools to diagnose and fix issues.

Comfortable defining and implementing test strategies (unit, UI, snapshot, and integration tests)

Awareness of accessibility and inclusive design basics on Android (e.g., Talkback, touch targets, contrast) and a desire to improve the accessibility of native experiences.

Experience working in cross functional Agile teams, collaborating with Product, Design, and other engineers, and communicating clearly about progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Familiarity with AI driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including thoughtful use of AI powered coding and productivity tools

Job Description:
Advanced Technologies Consultant
Position Summary
The Advanced Technologies Consultant supports clients in the effective, defensible, and commercially practical use of analytics, machine learning, and generative AI across eDiscovery, document review, investigations, early case assessment, privilege review, regulatory response, and related legal data workflows.
Working closely with Advanced Technologies leadership and cross-functional teams across Client Services, Document Review Services, Sales, Operations, and Information Technology, the Consultant serves as a client-facing subject matter expert. The role is responsible for helping clients identify appropriate workflows, configure and apply advanced technology solutions, explain technical and statistical concepts in clear business and legal terms, and ensure that projects are delivered efficiently, defensibly, and in line with client objectives.
This role is well suited to someone with strong eDiscovery experience, a consultative mindset, and a practical understanding of document review. A legal background, litigation support experience, or prior review management experience would be particularly valuable, as the Consultant will often need to bridge legal strategy, review execution, technology configuration, and client-facing advice.
The successful candidate must be comfortable managing multiple projects concurrently, working independently through ambiguity, collaborating across teams, and occasionally supporting urgent project needs outside standard business hours.
Key Responsibilities
• Serve as a subject matter expert on the use of advanced analytics, technology-assisted review, predictive coding, machine learning, and generative AI in eDiscovery and document review workflows.
• Consult with clients and internal stakeholders to understand matter objectives, legal and review requirements, data challenges, timelines, and desired outcomes.
• Design and recommend defensible workflows using tools such as TAR 1.0, TAR 2.0, active learning, AI-assisted classification, privilege identification, early case assessment, data reduction, and investigative analytics.
• Build, manage, validate, and refine analytics and AI models across platforms such as Relativity, Epiq AI, Reveal AI, and other advanced review or analytics platforms.
• Develop and refine prompts, instructions, classification criteria, and model guidance for generative AI and LLM-enabled tools, with a focus on consistency, quality, defensibility, and practical review outcomes.
• Advise clients and internal teams on appropriate use cases, limitations, risks, defensibility considerations, and quality control measures for AI-enabled review workflows.
• Explain statistical concepts, validation methodologies, sampling approaches, model performance, and review metrics to audiences with varying levels of technical, legal, and operational knowledge.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the full eDiscovery lifecycle, including data assessment, culling, review strategy, privilege workflows, production requirements, regulatory requests, and post-review analysis.
• Prepare recommended protocols, workflows, technical responses, reports, findings summaries, and client-ready explanations of proposed approaches and results.
• Support privilege-related workflows, including privilege identification, common-name normalisation, privilege log support, and procedural guidance for review teams.
• Partner with Client Services, Document Review Services, Operations, Sales, and Technology teams to ensure successful delivery of assigned projects.
• Document key project decisions, workflows, assumptions, and lessons learned, and transfer knowledge to review and client service teams to support repeatable and scalable delivery.
• Oversee or guide the work of analysts, associate consultants, review managers, or other project resources where appropriate.
• Track project successes, risks, lessons learned, and client outcomes, and contribute to internal reporting as required.
• Mentor colleagues and help build internal knowledge of analytics, AI, TAR, and advanced review workflows.
• Maintain subject matter expertise through continuing education, platform certifications, market awareness, and active engagement with developments in eDiscovery, legal technology, analytics, AI, and generative AI.
• Support business development activities where needed, including demonstrations, client presentations, training sessions, pre-sales discussions, and thought leadership.
Required Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum of 5 years’ client-facing experience in eDiscovery, litigation support, legal technology, document review, investigations, regulatory response, or a related field.
• Practical experience with eDiscovery review platforms, including Relativity Server and/or RelativityOne, and general administration of document review databases.
• Experience using technology-assisted review, predictive coding, active learning, analytics, machine learning, or generative AI tools in an eDiscovery or legal data context.
• Strong understanding of the eDiscovery lifecycle, including data processing, review strategy, review management, quality control, privilege, production, and defensibility considerations.
• Ability to translate complex technical, statistical, and workflow concepts into clear, client-ready advice.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with legal, technical, operational, and executive stakeholders.
• Excellent issue-spotting, problem-solving, critical thinking, and judgement.
• Strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent matters, priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel and other core productivity tools.
• Willingness to work flexibly when required by client demands, matter deadlines, productions, regulatory requests, or other urgent project needs.

Senior AI Platform Engineer - Knowledge & Reasoning
Location: Prague (Hybrid); Czech Republic (Remote); UK (Remote); Ghent (Hybrid), Poland (Remote), Hungary (Remote), Romania (Remote)
Function: Software Engineering
Reports to: Team Leader, Esko AI
About the role
The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed, we must ingest and leverage expert knowledge to augment the capabilities of our AI agents and services. This capability will be a key part of Esko’s centralized AI platform, enabling wider teams to build AI into their products using a common base.
Packaging workflows are governed by knowledge of very different kinds: regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, QRD), technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions, and practices that currently live in the heads of experts. Some of this knowledge is binding, some advisory, some contradictory, and much of it applies only to a particular customer, brand, or specific range of designs.
For AI systems to operate reliably in this environment, they must do more than retrieve relevant information. They need to determine which knowledge applies, distinguish mandatory requirements from guidance, handle missing or conflicting evidence, and recognize when human judgement is required.
We are building knowledge and reasoning as a shared capability of Esko's AI Platform, enabling product teams to create AI-powered workflows grounded in trusted, contextual knowledge. As part of the platform team, you will help shape and build this capability, taking end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas.
What you will do
• Design the knowledge representation: how constraints, transformations, procedures, and guidelines are modelled so that both agents and deterministic validators can use them, and so that humans can read, curate and correct them.
• Build and operate platform services for ingesting, curating, retrieving, and versioning knowledge, ensuring it is scoped correctly to the relevant customer and workflow context.
• Define how semantic retrieval, deterministic validation, and human review work together, including how applicability, uncertainty, conflicting evidence, and escalation are handled.
• Design and implement reusable APIs and tools that allow AI systems and deterministic services to apply, validate, and explain contextual knowledge.
• Build evaluation suites covering retrieval quality, applicability, conflict and ambiguity handling, and explanation quality, using measurable results as the primary evidence of progress.
• Take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas, including their security, tenant isolation, reliability, observability, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams.
• Work directly with domain experts and product engineering teams to turn informal expertise into structured, testable knowledge with clear provenance, citation, and release practices.
What we are looking for
• Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language.
• At least 5 years’ experience in a software engineering role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
• Experience building knowledge, retrieval, or rule systems that other teams depend on, and the judgement to choose the right formalism for a problem, whether that is a schema, decision table, rules engine, graph, or retrieval.
• Practical experience with RAG, information extraction, and structured validation (JSON Schema, Pydantic, or equivalent).
• Sound judgement when reasoning about applicability, exceptions, missing evidence, and ambiguity, including recognizing when a system should decline to answer or require human review.
• Experience constructing evaluation datasets, and the ability to write clearly about modelling decisions, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
• Undergraduate, Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines.
• Comfort operating at the boundary between a platform team and the domain engineering teams that consume it, balancing shared needs and central objectives against individual team priorities and timelines.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.
Preferred experience
• Semantic and symbolic tooling (RDF/OWL, SHACL, Datalog, DMN, production rule engines, policy-as-code).
• Agentic systems with tools calling and validation-before-action.
• Multi-tenant SaaS with strict isolation and audit requirements.
• Experience in a high-accountability domain such as pharmaceutical or food labelling, and legal technology.
• Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry.
What success looks like
• Delivery of the knowledge module, conforming to agreed specifications and architecture, in a way that delivers measurable improvements in AI agent and service effectiveness (e.g. increased end-user productivity).
• Product teams build shared knowledge services rather than constructing their own.
• Agents apply the correct tenant-, market-, and customer-specific constraints with measurably high recall, can explain which knowledge items influenced a recommendation or validation result, and escalate rather than guess when knowledge is ambiguous, conflicting, or absent.
• Tenant-specific knowledge never crosses tenant boundaries.
• The knowledge base itself is versioned, tested, legible – and curatable by the humans who must ultimately stand behind it.
• Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko’s Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices.
• The knowledge module grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.
What We Offer

Big responsibility. Personal support. That’s Beyond the Ordinary.
Want to get stuck into client work, build your confidence and start shaping your career from day one? Welcome to the Audit Graduate Programme at BDO.
The programme starts on Monday, 20th September 2027, for an organisation-wide induction (you need to be able to attend).
A bit about Audit
Audit at BDO gives you the chance to take on meaningful work early in your career. We’re the only UK mid-market organisation with more than £1bn in turnover and 8,000 people. That means you get the scale and breadth of a major professional services business, while working with clients where your contribution can make a real difference.
Our Audit teams work across specialist areas including Pension Audit, Public Sector, Not-for-Profit, Financial Services and Technology Risk Assurance, helping deliver high-quality audits that businesses and their stakeholders can trust.
You’ll be trusted with lots of responsibility, but you won’t be expected to figure everything out by yourself. You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues, managers, directors and partners who are there to answer questions, share what they know and help you develop.
It’s a chance to learn by doing, get exposure to clients and build your confidence as your responsibility grows. Big responsibility, with the scale of BDO behind you and personal support around you.
And a bit about the programme
Over three years, you’ll build hands-on experience while working towards a recognised professional qualification, the ACA.
Alongside your studies, you’ll develop your technical and commercial skills through real Audit work. You could gain experience across different clients, sectors and specialist areas, while learning from people across the organisation.
As you develop, so will the responsibility you’re trusted with. Our graduates have talked about joining client calls, leading meetings and working directly with senior colleagues earlier than they expected. You’ll have support around you as you take those next steps and build towards where you want your career to go.
When you successfully complete the programme and pass the exams, you’ll be fully qualified as an accountant, and guaranteed a permanent role with us.
As for you
You’re curious, resilient and adaptable. You’re ready to learn, ask questions and take on more responsibility as you grow.
Bring your problem-solving, analytical skills and critical thinking. We’ll give you opportunities to put them into practice, alongside the support to keep developing.
Join us in our Nottingham hub.
One thing to note: you’ll need to live within a commutable distance of the office you apply to. Relocation support is not provided, so please consider this carefully before applying. Time together in person matters – whether that’s in the office or with clients. It gives you more opportunities to learn from your team, build relationships and get the most from working together.

• A minimum 2:2 degree in any discipline (obtained or predicted)

• GCSEs at grade 4 and above in Maths and English, or Scottish National 5 grade A-C. You’ll also need to provide evidence if successful
• Commitment to balance study and professional work
• The right to work in the UK (we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for these roles as they do not meet the current minimum salary requirements for sponsorship set by the Home Office. Applications from candidates who have their own legal right to work within the UK must cover the duration of their 3-year training contract and employment)
How the interview process will go
We want you to know what to expect, so here’s the typical process:
• Online application form.
• Online assessments.
• Video interview.
• Virtual assessment centre.
• Final interview in person.
We’ll keep you updated at each stage and share tips to help you prepare. And just so you know: we don’t use AI in any part of our candidate screening process. Every application is reviewed by a real person.

Our benefits are designed to support your life in and outside of work, with options including additional leave, gym membership and employee discounts, alongside pension, health and wellbeing support and a range of protection benefits.

The opportunity to build your experience, confidence and career without having to do it alone.

Role overview
The Finance Technology Product Lead is a senior technology partner to the Finance function, responsible for helping shape and deliver technology-enabled change needed to support the firm's finance strategy and priorities.
Working collaboratively with Finance Services and Technology teams, the role acts as a key interface between Finance and IT. It will help Finance identify and articulate business problems and opportunities, shape demand, develop technology roadmaps and investment cases, and bring together the right capabilities to deliver change successfully.
The role will also provide leadership across significant Finance technology programmes and initiatives, ensuring that priorities are translated into coherent plans, dependencies are understood, risks and decisions are actively managed, and activity remains aligned to the intended business outcomes.
This is not a role responsible for the day-to-day ownership or administration of the firm's core finance systems. Instead, the Finance Technology Product Lead provides the technology leadership, challenge, coordination and programme oversight required to ensure that Finance initiatives are well understood, appropriately prioritised and effectively delivered in collaboration with a global enterprise IT function.

• Able to operate across organisational boundaries and lead multidisciplinary teams without relying on direct line-management authority.

• Strong understanding of programme governance, dependency management, risk management, planning and benefits realisation.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems.
• Commercially aware and comfortable developing business cases and recommendations for technology investment.
• Highly organised, self-directed and comfortable managing several initiatives at different stages of their lifecycle.
Desired Experience
• Experience working with Finance functions or delivering technology change involving financial processes.
• Understanding of the technology needs of a professional-services or similarly complex global organisation.
• Familiarity with enterprise finance platforms such as Elite 3E, or comparable ERP / practice-management systems.
• Understanding of legal-sector finance concepts such as matter management, time recording, billing, work in progress and financial reporting.

Perform assessments and communicate to stakeholders on the likelihood of exploitation and potential impact of vulnerabilities, misconfiguration findings, and other potential vectors to determine the appropriate course of action to mitigate potential risk.
Leverage Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) technology to assess findings and contribute guidance and expertise to application custodians on fixing issues.
Act as a security liaison between Information Security and the Development staff to bring a security mindset to the software development lifecycle. Assess and understand the Wellington CI/CD pipeline to be able to provide recommendations to developers for securing their code.
Lead urgent vulnerability response, misconfiguration events, or otherwise assist with Cyber Defense as needed.
Use scripting and AI to automate manual workflows, assist with data assessments, and shorten time gaps from ideas to outputs.
Develop and mature an internal security hardening and baselines program. This effort develops standards and processes to ensure attack surface risk is reduced, and configuration baselines are met both according to CIS Controls and cyber threats actively targeting the firm.
Stay up to date with current and relevant cyber security threats as well as any associated countermeasures. Participate in internal meetings to map industry cyber threats to our current attack surface.
Review of both internal and open-source threat intelligence sources for recently disclosed vulnerabilities at risk of introduction into the Wellington environment.
Work with our Third-Party Risk team to engage third parties in Wellington’s vendor ecosystem to understand when third and fourth parties may be exposed to critical vulnerabilities.
Contribute to team documentation for updates to existing processes, new processes, assessment tool infrastructure details and workflows.
Contribute to firmwide documentation by being an SME contributor to policies and standards.
NON-TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
A Passion for cyber-security is a must.
Ability to self-motivate, with an eagerness to dig into potential risks. Ask questions, be curious, dig deeper.
BS degree in Information Systems/related discipline or equivalent IT work experience
Experience in developing new processes and procedures that match evolving attack surfaces.
Excellent oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to effectively interact with teams representing a wide variety of technical disciplines.
Ability to work with global teams effectively.
Ability to mentor junior team members and share discoveries about your work.
TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
Experience working with both WIZ CNAPP and Qualys vulnerability management platforms.
Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment software and prioritizing results using a combination of various frameworks tied to internal objects (CVE, CVSS, EPSS, etc.).
Knowledge of common cyber-attack types such as DDoS, SQLi, XSS, and others. This experience is relied upon to make rational decisions in our baselines program.
Previous experience assessing, documenting, and communicating information security risk, particularly related to cyber vulnerabilities is preferred.
Experience in the use of common scripting languages such as python to automate job functions.
Working knowledge of IaC (Infrastructure as Code) concepts, especially with AWS.
Knowledge in the areas of network architecture and engineering and software application development
Working knowledge of the use of threat intelligence feeds and resources
Preferred: Experience working with Splunk, JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Curation (or similar), ServiceNow, AWS Services, MS Azure, MS Intune, Anthropic Claude
Preferred: Home labs, security practitioner meetups, research, we would love to hear it!

You will be responsible for directing the product quality and reliability team at Newport UK, to ensure we develop, implement, and maintain best-in-class reliability for Discrete Si, SiC and power ICs.  Handles technical investigative actions for highly complex customer issues or highly complex product qualification issues. Defines and specifies the implementation of standards, methods, and procedures for product quality and reliability of Division products.  Participates in the reviewing of engineering designs to contribute quality and reliability requirements and considerations.  Directs the assistance of product support areas in gathering and analyzing data.  Selects, develops, and evaluates Reliability personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. Job Location:
The position will be filled within our Vishay offices in Newport, UK.
What you will be doing:
• Oversee the Newport Reliability function to implement quality systems, guidelines, plans and policies to effectively ensure the highest quality and reliability of the company’s products.
• Support key customer issues to achieve quality standards, systems and objectives utilizing appropriate procedures and cost savings methods.
• Participate in the reviewing of engineering designs with R&D and Engineering group to contribute quality and reliability requirements and considerations. This includes working with R&D design team to assess reliability and burn-in for new technology platforms and new products
• Direct the assistance of product support areas in gathering and analyzing data.
• Select and manage appropriate subordinate reliability at Newport team to ensure smooth coverage of quality and reliability functions.

• Continue building internal Reliability best-in-class standard and practice with respect to new materials or new technologies
• Design and drive the enablement of world-class Quality and Reliability requirements for wide-bandgap (SiC) power product release to the market, that meet both industry standards (JEDEC and AEC) and customer requirements
• Establish the industry best-in-class methodology to test and to characterize SiC power semiconductor devices to understand their reliability during R&D, Transfer (New Product Introduction or NPI) and High-Volume-Manufacturing (HVM).
• Design experiments and co-ordinate statistical studies to determine device reliability, for example gate oxide lifetime marathon test, time-dependent dielectric breakdown.
• Lead and collaborate with R&D, Engineering and Operation in establishing screening and burn-in procedures for SiC power devices to meet product quality requirements, to comply to industry requirement (JEDEC and AEC) and to meet specifics customer requirements (e.g. Board Level Reliability) during R&D, NPI  and HVM.

• 5+ years of experience in the field of wide-bandgap power semiconductor technology (ideally SiC).
• Experience leading global team in reliability testing of SiC MOSFETs and diodes, both at wafer- and package-level; preferred to have GaN experiences as well.
• A good understanding of statistical analysis and design of experiments.
• Knowledge of semiconductor TCAD tools for device simulation, i.e. Synopsys Sentaurus, Silvaco Victory;
• Excellent leadership and problem-solving skills – able to identify problems and/or opportunities for improvement and assesses viable solutions. Develop and execute comprehensive action plans.

Who are we
Knight Frank Investment Management (KFIM) operates as the specialist property investment arm of Knight Frank LLP, delivering tailored investment and asset management solutions to institutional investors and high-net-worth clients across the UK and international markets. As part of one of the world’s leading privately owned real estate consultancies, KFIM combines global reach with independent investment expertise to drive long-term performance.
At the core of KFIM’s offering is a commitment to delivering more than traditional investment management. The business provides both discretionary and advisory services, managing property portfolios and funds through a range of strategies, including core, core-plus and value-add approaches. By focusing on active asset management and market-led decision making, KFIM aims to generate strong, stable income returns complemented by capital growth over time.
Clients are central to everything KFIM delivers. Working in close partnership, the team develops bespoke investment strategies aligned to each client’s objectives, risk profile and market outlook. Leveraging extensive relationships, local market knowledge and Knight Frank’s global platform, KFIM provides access to opportunities, insights and specialist expertise across sectors and geographies, ensuring informed and confident investment decisions.
KFIM’s strength lies in its people and its entrepreneurial approach. Operating as an independent business within the Knight Frank group, the team combines robust governance with the flexibility to select best-in-class partners and respond quickly to evolving market conditions. This collaborative, hands-on approach underpins a strong track record of performance and a reputation for accountability, innovation and client alignment.
Through its focus on active asset management, disciplined investment processes and long-term partnerships, Knight Frank Investment Management continues to support clients in unlocking value, enhancing portfolio performance and achieving sustainable real estate investment success. Learn more about what sets us apart here.
About The Role
Knight Frank Investment Management (KFIM) is the specialist property investment management arm of Knight Frank. With access to over 125 years of real estate experience and expertise, KFIM combines the agility and independence of a specialist investment management business with the reach, insight and resources of the world’s largest privately owned property consultancy.
Operating across the UK and European markets, KFIM partners with institutional and private investors to deliver considered, performance-led real estate investment solutions.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a junior Investment Manager to join KFIM and support the management of commercial separate account mandates for institutional and private investors.
Working closely with Senior Investment Managers and Portfolio Managers, you will play a key role in executing investment strategies across diverse UK portfolios, including industrial, retail, hotels and office assets.
This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact. You will develop and implement asset management strategies, analyse acquisition and disposal opportunities, monitor performance, and deliver value for clients, with a strong focus on absolute returns, income generation and sustainability.
What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will:
• Manage a range of commercial property assets, ensuring investment objectives are met.
• Create and implement detailed asset plans that support performance across portfolios.
• Use financial modelling and scenario analysis to assess risks, returns and strategic options.
• Assist in preparing investment papers, quarterly reports and client presentations, translating property and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Collaborate with senior leadership, internal specialists and wider Knight Frank teams.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with agency and professional service providers.
• Support investment transactions and help source opportunities aligned to portfolio strategies.
• Work closely with the Head of ESG to advance sustainability initiatives.
• Engage with and oversee third-party service providers to ensure excellence across portfolio management activity.
What We’re Looking For:
We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded real estate professional who brings:
• 0 to 2 years’ post-qualification experience.
• RICS qualification and a relevant degree.
• Experience in asset management or valuation ideally within UK commercial property.
• A desire to develop into a client-facing role.
• Strong financial analysis skills, with the ability to interpret data and support investment decision-making.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build lasting relationships.
• A critical-thinking mindset and strong attention to detail.
• A collaborative approach and the confidence to work across teams, clients and external partners.
• A genuine passion for real estate investment and sustainable investment outcomes.
Why Join Us?
At KFIM, you will join a business where autonomy meets support. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful investment decisions, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape strategies that drive performance for institutional and private investors.
You will be part of a team that values partnership, innovation and robust governance, while benefiting from the strength and reach of Knight Frank’s global network.
If you are passionate about real estate investment and want to build your career within a specialist investment management business backed by a global property brand, we would love to hear from you.
Apply now to join Knight Frank Investment Management as an Investment Manager.
Competitive Salary

Job Description
Broadcast Engineer (Projects Focused)
Your Role: Broadcast Engineer (Projects Focused)
Based at our Leicester Square headquarters and reporting to the Managing Engineer & Broadcast Projects, London, you will support the technology behind Global’s radio, podcast, video and digital content. This is a hands-on, project-focused role, with responsibility for supporting live, business-critical systems and assisting the wider Engineering team when needed.
As a Broadcast Engineer (Projects Focused) at Global, you will:
Key Responsibilities
• Deliver technical projects: Assist with the installation, commissioning, upgrade and documentation of broadcast studios, production facilities and associated technical systems.
• Support live broadcast operations: Maintain and support live radio, podcast, audio and video production environments, resolving faults quickly and methodically to minimise disruption.
• Work across broadcast technology: Support studio audio, routing and Audio-over-IP systems; radio playout and automation platforms including RCS Zetta and GSelector; and video, ingest, streaming and production systems.
• Partner with production teams: Provide practical technical support to presenters, producers, journalists, creators and other teams, including for Outside Broadcasts, live events and temporary facilities.
• Maintain reliable ways of working: Keep technical documentation up to date and follow incident and change-management processes. Participate in the engineering on-call rota for urgent issues outside normal working hours.
What You’ll Love About This Role
Think Big: Support well-known Global brands and content across live radio, podcasts, video and events.
Own It: Take ownership of technical issues and projects, helping to deliver dependable broadcast systems.
Keep it Simple: Turn complex technical problems into clear, practical solutions for colleagues.
Better Together: Work closely with Engineering, Programming, News, Podcasts, Video and Technology teams.
What Success Looks Like
In your first few months, you’ll have:
• Built a strong working knowledge of Leicester Square’s broadcast and production systems.
• Developed effective relationships across Engineering and content teams.
• Become confident diagnosing common studio, playout, audio, video and network-related faults.
• Learned Global’s incident management, documentation and on-call processes.
• Contributed to the successful delivery of technical projects and upgrades.
What You’ll Need
• Live broadcast experience: Practical experience supporting a live broadcast or production environment.
• Technical problem-solving: Strong fault-finding skills and the ability to remain calm and effective when supporting live output.
• Audio and radio systems knowledge: Understanding of audio signal flow, studio systems and radio automation platforms such as RCS Zetta and GSelector, or similar.
• Video and IP capability: Knowledge of video production, ingest, storage, routing, switching and streaming systems, alongside IP networking including multicast.
• Audio-over-IP and IT awareness: Familiarity with technologies such as Livewire, AES67 and Dante, and an understanding of software- and IP-based broadcast systems.
• Collaboration and communication: Ability to work independently while communicating clearly and effectively with a wider technical and production team.

As the Sr QA Co-Ordinator, you will be responsible for Leading, managing and co-ordinating 2 small Remote teams the Development QA Team who’s primary purpose is assist the Developers of the project in their pursuit of Quality and the Functional QA Team, who’s primary role is to run test plans and playthroughs. With a focus on leadership, you will be focused on developing both wings of the remote team, managing performance, assisting innovating in their assigned areas and managing priorities and work load, and assisting the QA manager and the internal team.
We are looking for someone who is experienced in leading staff, ideally with experience in development QA / quality assistance / push left QA approach. They must have good initiative, and autonomy, and have a passion for people management and development. Staff development and mentoring through 1 to 1s, resolving issues both personal and professional will play a big part of the role. Must be experienced in leading remote teams.
What you’ll be doing
Reporting to the QA manager, your role as a Sr QA Co-ordinator will predominately hands off the game role, where the focus will be on directly leadership, mentoring the team members to strive for success, keeping them motivated and assisting them develop there on skills and the processes that they use in there assigned area to best assist the development team.
the role will also involve quality control and assessment of the team, monitoring and helping the QA Manager create useful KPI’s and other metrics to objectively assess the team, autonomously challenging falling performance and weak areas.
The Dev QA Team are responsible for assisting the Development team in whatever suits the needs of the team at the present time, this may be far more than just testing and creating bugs and test plans, but creating bespoke processes and ways to support the team in their current focus or challenges
The Functional QA team are responsible for ensuring that the breadth of the game is tested and does not regress as other areas are developed as well as having a pivotal role in logging and defects and supporting build delivery’s and landings
On a day-to-day basis, you will:
• Assisting the QA manager in creating, maintaining and recording team KPI’s
• Monitoring the issue database and Teams communication channels for quality in defects reports and proactively assisting the team in achieving the highest quality of communication possible
• Be responsible for ensuring that your team are supporting their assigned teams needs
• Holding regular weekly 121s with the Dev QA team
• Assist the QA Manager in holding team meetings, retrospectives and planning sessions
• Oversee the creation and maintenance of the projects test case database
• Assist in quality control of defect report and the bug database as a whole
• Generally support the cohesion of the external teams with each other and the internal QA team
• Creating reporting on the Teams progress and performance for the QA Manager
• Acquire in depth knowledge of core features for the title, from development, to releas and all the way though to post-launch support.
• Be a role model for staff, mentoring and supporting them in their own career goals.
• Assist the Sr Dev QA and QA Manager managing cover and absence on the team
• Attending Development team retrospectives and planning sessions to gain context and understanding of the wider team
• Assisting the dissemination of information from the internal in-office and ensuring the remote Dev QA team are kept in the loop of the most recent changes and decisions made by the internal team
• Holding performance reviews with the external QA manager
• This role will involve making trips to Sofia, Bulgaria to spend face time with the remote team
• Running Dev QA team retrospectives and planning sessions
• Assisting the QA Manager in constantly innovating, iterating and tailoring Dev QA processes to achieve maximum efficiency on the team
• Attending daily stand ups with internal QA team to align on the day to day work
• Testing the game holistically as an end user
• Assisting the QA>Dev Feedback loop and process
• To work alongside the External QA Leadership to Quality control the Functional QA Team, managing coverage, as well as consistency of performance and general development of the functional QA teams capabilities
What we are looking for
Essential
• Experience in Directly manging and mentoring remote teams
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to relay important information in the most suited format.
• Previous experience in a leadership role within the game industry particularly QA
• Knowledge on “Quality assistance, push left, development QA”

Ideas | People | Trust
We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions businesses need to navigate today’s changing world.
Our clients are Britain’s economic engine – ambitious, entrepreneurially-spirited and high‑growth businesses that fuel the economy - and the owners and management teams that lead them.
We’ll broaden your horizons
Our Advisory team provide a wide variety of services that deliver value-led advice and outcomes. They have an in-depth knowledge of business, industry sectors and markets and understand the constantly changing risks and opportunities at the heart of affairs. The team work across strategy, operations and improvement as well as at a transactional and defined project level. From technology to risk advisory, they’re experts in following through on top-level instructions and resolving the finer details – all in one straight-forward package. When you join them, you’ll work on some of the world's most exciting financial operations and business deals, building your experience and expertise alongside the brightest minds in the industry.
We’ll help you succeed
Our clients trust us because of the quality of our advice.  That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with clients and building long-lasting relationships.
You’ll be someone who can work pro-actively, managing your own tasks, but you’ll also be confident collaborating with others, communicating regularly with senior managers, Directors, and BDO’s Partners to enable us to serve our clients effectively.  You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to our clients.
Overview
As an Assistant Manager within our Risk Advisory Services (RAS) team, you will play a key role in delivering high‑quality internal audit and advisory engagements for a diverse range of clients. You will take responsibility for leading defined engagements or workstreams, supporting engagement planning and delivery, and ensuring work is completed to a high standard in line with BDO methodology.
You will work closely with Managers, Senior Managers, Directors and Partners, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the effective delivery of engagements. Alongside this, you will support the development of junior team members and continue to build your technical capability, professional judgement and leadership skills as you progress towards Manager level.
The role combines engagement and portfolio management with hands on delivery. Typically, you will spend around 50% of your time on management activities—such as engagement planning, portfolio oversight and project management—and 50% leading audits and undertaking specialist assignments, with this balance flexing in line with your experience and development.
You’ll be someone with:
• Relevant experience in internal audit or equivalent risk and assurance work, with involvement in planning, delivering and reviewing audit or advisory engagements.
• An inquisitive and proactive mindset, with the confidence to challenge constructively, think critically about risks and controls, and contribute ideas that enhance audit quality and ways of working.
• Experience in risk management, internal audit or systems / controls testing, with the ability to apply this knowledge pragmatically across different client environments.
• A recognised professional qualification, or working towards one (e.g. CIA / CMIIA / MIIA, CCAB or equivalent).
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with clients and stakeholders.
• Good organisational and time‑management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and contribute to the delivery of a small portfolio of client engagements under manager oversight.
• A collaborative and development‑focused approach, with an interest in supporting and coaching junior team members, flexibility to travel to client sites as required, and an interest in using data analytics or emerging AI‑enabled audit techniques.
At BDO, we’ll help you achieve your personal goals and career ambitions, and we have programmes, resources, and frameworks that provide clarity and structure around career development.
We’re in it together
Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture.  From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.
We can provide the best support for our clients and people when we’re working side by side.  Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another.  At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.
We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for our clients and satisfying experiences at work, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices.  BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences.  With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.
We’re looking forward to the future
At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy.
Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in them. Across the UK thousands of unique minds coming together to help our clients reach their ambitions.
We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better.

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.
With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.
Make an Impact as a Senior Biostatistician at Worldwide
As a Senior Biostatistician, you will provide expert statistical leadership across clinical projects and sponsor programmes, helping ensure that study design, analysis, and reporting activities are delivered with scientific rigour and quality. Your expertise will directly support the generation of reliable clinical evidence that informs important development decisions.
Working closely with sponsors, cross-functional teams, and external partners, you'll act as a trusted statistical consultant, contributing to study design, analysis strategies, reporting, and regulatory-compliant deliverables. You'll also play a key role in driving process improvements, supporting innovation, and enhancing the efficiency and quality of statistical operations.
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on technical expertise with strategic statistical leadership, making a meaningful impact across multiple clinical development programmes.
Where You'll Work
This is a remote role open to candidates based in UK or Europe. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do
• Lead statistical support for clinical projects and sponsor programmes, ensuring high-quality and timely consultancy throughout the study lifecycle.
• Provide expert review and guidance on study designs, statistical analysis plans, protocols, and clinical study reports.
• Partner with sponsors and internal teams to develop robust statistical methodologies, randomisation strategies, and analysis approaches.
• Develop, review, validate, and maintain SAS programs for clinical data analysis, CDISC datasets (SDTM and ADaM), and statistical reporting outputs.
• Deliver statistical reporting activities, including specifications for tables, figures, listings, derived datasets, and final study deliverables.
• Collaborate with internal departments, sponsors, and external stakeholders to address statistical issues and reporting requirements.
• Drive process and system improvements that enhance the quality, efficiency, and consistency of clinical study data processing and reporting.
• Contribute to publications, presentations, bid support activities, statistical policies, quality initiatives, and audit readiness efforts.
What You'll Bring
• Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or another discipline with a strong statistical component.
• Extensive hands-on experience as a project biostatistician, providing statistical leadership across clinical research projects.
• Strong expertise in clinical trial design, statistical analysis, reporting methodologies, and statistical consultancy.
• Advanced SAS programming skills, including experience with derived datasets, CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards, tables, figures, and listings.
• Knowledge of relevant regulatory guidance and industry standards, including ICH requirements, FDA Quality System Regulation (21 CFR Part 11), and related clinical research regulations.
• Experience reviewing and producing statistical analysis plans, study reports, and publication-quality outputs.
• Strong stakeholder management, communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
• Proficiency in English.
Discover the Difference
We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit http://www.worldwide.com/careers, or connect with us on LinkedIn.

About Us
Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.
Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

•
World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.
Job Summary
The Director, Corporate Planning is the single-point owner of SHI's enterprise-wide corporate planning agenda.
The role designs, leads and executes the company's end-to-end planning process, and is accountable for three things:
• Defining how the business plans: the calendar, governance, standards and operating rhythm.
• Establishing the strategic and financial assumptions that underpin the plan.
• Translating plans into a coherent, consolidated financial model that supports executive decision-making.
This is a senior, highly visible leadership role requiring executive presence, independent judgement and the credibility to act as a trusted partner to the Finance Leadership team and senior business leaders. It runs a business-led planning cycle in which segment and function leaders own their numbers, while this role sets the parameters, challenges submissions, consolidates the outcome and holds the calendar.
Role Description
Enterprise planning ownership (end to end)
• Own the full planning lifecycle: annual operating plan, reforecast process, rolling monthly latest view, 3–5 year long-range model and strategic scenario planning.
• Define and maintain the planning calendar, templates, milestones, submission process and checkpoint reviews.
• Ensure outputs are timely, decision-oriented and aligned to strategy rather than mechanically produced.
Strategic plan design and executive alignment
• Partner with the Finance leadership team to translate enterprise strategy into a financial plan and to frame priorities, trade-offs and investment choices.
• Set planning parameters and assumptions with the CFO and relevant leadership ahead of each cycle opening.
• Act as the primary FP&A interface to executive leadership during the cycle; represent the planning function at executive meetings with clear strategic insight.
• Constructively challenge assumptions and elevate discussion beyond incremental budgeting.
Corporate financial model and consolidation
• Design and own the corporate planning model, ensuring scalability across sales segments and business units, consistency of assumptions, and clean consolidation and reconciliation.
• Build and maintain the driver models behind planning: revenue and gross profit, cost and headcount.
• Own the target-setting cascade from the top-down goal to segment and function level, including target and capacity modelling.
• Maintain a clear audit trail and version control across planning iterations.
Business engagement and rollout
• Lead the rollout of the corporate plan through clear guidance, structured templates and consistent assumptions.
• Pressure-test segment and function submissions and hold process discipline across functions.
• Own the pack for check-in reviews and consolidate submissions into a single coherent position; present risks and opportunities.
Planning governance, risk and continuous improvement
• Establish planning standards and governance covering assumption management, scenario discipline and change control.
• Analyse forecast accuracy by segment and driver after each cycle (where we missed, by how much and why) and feed findings into the next cycle's assumptions and methodology.
• Own the process improvement agenda, including tooling, automation and the practical use of AI, to reduce cycle time and increase executive confidence in outputs.
• Ensure planning processes comply with accounting standards, regulatory requirements and data protection obligations, and support financial risk management by flagging exposure early.
Team leadership
• Provide leadership to the planning function: begin as a hands-on leader and build a team as the function matures.
• Foster a culture of financial discipline, shared responsibility and continuous improvement; coach and develop team members.
Other
• Lead and support on FP&A and Corporate finance projects
• Support M&A
• Support Quarterly business reviews (QBR) design, implementation and process
Behaviors and Competencies
• Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.
• Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.
• Business Acumen: Can provide strategic guidance and insights to drive overall business success.
• Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.
• Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.
• Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.
• Financial Awareness: Can provide financial guidance and strategic planning
• Detail-Oriented: Can foster a culture of detail orientation, inspiring others to maintain high standards of accuracy and completeness in their work.
• Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.
• Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.
Skill Level Requirements
• Overseeing operational processes and procedures to ensure alignment with legal regulations, ethical standards, and business objectives. - Expert
• Ability to identify and mitigate risks, aligning with the responsibility of safeguarding the organization’s operations and reputation. - Expert
• Proficiency in building and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives and organizational success. - Expert

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your role in the team:
Your focus will be enabling IG to gain optimal value from the Data we create, hold and process. You’ll work with stakeholders at every level to help
shape a vision and strategy to help IG build world class tools and processes that enable us to leverage our data to create insights, make decisions and identify opportunities. You’ll drive the adoption of enabling data tools to bring the value in our data to everyone at IG.
To do this, you’ll work with our Data Engineering teams in India, the UK and elsewhere to shape our Roadmaps and Product Backlogs, prioritising the products and services we’ll build to realise our future vision.
You’ll understand the importance of balancing the development of capabilities, products and services whilst ensuring our teams have the space and time to make our platforms robust, performant and less limited by technical debt.
You’ll have evidence of working with Cloud Data platforms like Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and be able to help create context and understanding with non-technical stakeholders and engineers alike. • Collaborate with Product Management to achieve your Product Vision and define a wider Strategy.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Architecture on improvements to ways of working and process.
• Collaborate with Project and Programme management where needed to drive and deliver data outcomes or where there are dependencies on doing so.
• Help drive Product Management culture, mindset & principles by advocating for improvement and sharing methods, principles, and practice.
• Share learned knowledge, practices, and methods to help the Product team grow.
• Help shape and define metrics we can use to measure progress both in terms of product / service impact and progress.

• Define and communicate to the team and stakeholders, the users/customers of your products & services to better align your vision with valuable unmet needs.
• Help Product and Platform leadership define and execute an iterative strategy that enables IG teams to build better products using common platform services.
• Engage with vendors and 3rd parties where needed to help bring to IG the best commercial partners to help achieve your Product Vision.

You’re curious about things like the client experience, the rapid developments in tech, and the complex world of fintech regulation. You’re also a
confident, creative thinker with a knack for innovating. We know that you know every problem has a solution. Here, you can try new ideas, and lead the way in creating inspiring experiences for our clients and everyone around you.
We don’t fit the corporate stereotype. If you want to work for a traditional, suit-and-tie corporate that just gives you a pay cheque at the end of the
month, we might not be for you. But, if you have that IG Group energy and you can stand behind what we believe in, let’s raise the bar together.

Overview
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
About the Team
We believe that as we grow individually, we also grow as an Information Technology team allowing us to contribute to the overall growth of Houlihan Lokey. We embrace challenges and try new things, always looking for ways to improve. We deliver technology products and services enabled everywhere, so business can happen anywhere. We like where we work, who we work with, and what we do. We cultivate a culture where we all thrive.
Description:
IT governance, risk, and compliance sit at the center of how Houlihan Lokey protects client trust and operates as a global financial institution. As a GRC Analyst, you help ensure that the technology powering the firm's business runs on a foundation of strong controls, sound risk management, and continuous regulatory readiness — work that matters more with every new regulation, threat, and client expectation the industry takes on.
Working alongside a Lead GRC Analyst and reporting to the IT GRC Manager, you will support governance, risk, and compliance efforts spanning frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and Sarbanes-Oxley, partnering with internal and external auditors and control owners across the enterprise. It's an ideal opportunity for someone with 2–3 years of GRC or IT audit experience who wants to build a career at the intersection of technology, risk, and financial services, inside a team that will invest in your growth from day one.
Key Responsibilities:
• Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of IT governance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
• Assist in identifying, evaluating, and tracking IT risks — including cybersecurity, data privacy, and operational risk — and contribute to risk mitigation plans that address identified vulnerabilities.
• Partner with HL Compliance to ensure IT systems align with regulations such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, and other standards relevant to the financial services industry.
• Conduct assurance activities, including security assessments and issue management, and collaborate with IT teams to strengthen security compliance and the overall control environment.
• Plan and execute IT audits that evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes, supporting remediation tracking under the guidance of the Lead GRC Analyst and IT GRC Manager.
• Prepare clear, well-organized reports and documentation on IT governance, risk, and compliance activities for review by team leadership.
• Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders — including auditors, regulators, and clients — on GRC-related matters, including timely, accurate responses to client security questionnaires.
• Support the development of IT governance and compliance training materials in partnership with IT, Compliance, and Audit teams.
• Contribute to vendor risk management, including assessing SOC reports and ISO certifications and applying a clear understanding of vendor risk tiering.
Qualifications & Experience:
Required
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
• 2–3 years of experience in IT governance, risk management, compliance, or IT audit, ideally within the financial services industry.
• Working knowledge of IT regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, and SOX, or comparable international standards.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and help mitigate risk effectively.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred
• Progress toward, or interest in, professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, Security+, or equivalent.
• Familiarity with GRC or audit management platforms and tools.
• Awareness of NIST and COBIT frameworks.
• Strong Excel skills, including data management and functions such as VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, and XMATCH.
• Experience preparing materials for internal and external audit requests.
• Understanding of vendor risk management, including SOC report and ISO certification review.
Soft Skills:
• Communicate with clarity and professionalism, balancing accuracy with approachability across a range of audiences.
• Bring a solutions-focused mindset, willing to go above and beyond to create positive outcomes.
• Demonstrate high emotional intelligence, staying calm, positive, and thoughtful in challenging situations.
• Approach work with curiosity and a growth-oriented mindset, continuously building GRC and technical expertise.
• Operate with a high degree of professionalism and dependability, with a commitment to the firm's mission and values.
• Stay comfortable working with AI-enabled GRC, audit, and analytics tools, using them to streamline risk assessments, control testing, and reporting.

Create new project-specific applications using Vector tools and National Instruments packages for testing

Technical approval of data analysis scripts

Experience in the use of HALT/HASS, accelerated life testing, dynamometers or vibration and laboratory equipment to set up and carry out tests

Experience in testing of motors, controllers or other powertrain systems

Experience working with high voltage systems up to 1500Vdc

Demonstrated track record of engineering ability in an electrical or mechanical discipline

Strong analytical and judgment skills including the ability to troubleshoot and advise on solutions in the area of testing.

Instinctive problem-solving skills coupled with a sound analytical approach

Job Title
